findings.description: Spot scored-execution authority gate inconsistent with the A1 ruling at the audited bytes. (1) research/control/forex_ng1_run/p1_spot/spot_authority_proof.json -- the declared gate source of truth, read fail-closed by research/assets/forex_ng1/spot_series.py::require_scored_authority (raises unless authority_status.scored_consumption == 'AUTHORIZED') -- records scored_consumption='CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED' at ffdc128. (2) The ruling AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_RESEARCH exists ONLY as event SPOT_AUTHORITY_RULING in research/control/FOREX_NG1/event_log.jsonl (13:37:24Z); no committed artifact was updated. (3) The proof artifact itself prescribes the remedy: 'To authorize: set authority_status.scored_consumption=AUTHORIZED in this committed artifact together with the recorded terms' -- not executed, and the terms text does not exist anywhere in evidence (terms_url=None disclosed; no Twelve Data entry in the platform-v3 GA4 authority table or registry journal). (4) accounting.compute_outcomes independently refuses any spot_authority string != 'AUTHORIZED', and the ruling string 'AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_RESEARCH' would also be refused. Consequence: a GO typed on the current bytes makes E deterministically NOT_RUN all six cells (wasted one-shot), and any post-GO flip of the gate would occur after outcome-visible code paths are armed. Launch-blocking state; claim of scored-execution readiness is false in this one mechanical respect. FIX BEFORE GO (not by A7, which does not modify evidence): commit the proof update per the artifact's own remedy WITH recorded terms/entitlement evidence, then re-present for the gate; no re-run of the technical chain is required by this finding.

authority_assessment.question: Is the Twelve Data terms-documentation gap (terms_url=None, no terms text anywhere in evidence, owner existing entitlement) a refusal-grade HIGH for scored spot consumption?
authority_assessment.independent_position: NO on the substance; the refusal driver is the unexecuted gate, not the terms gap itself. My independent reasoning: (1) The channel is a paid commercial API consumed under the owner's EXISTING entitlement -- no new purchase or signup occurred or is required, so none of the plan sec0 delegation exclusions (purchases, signups, credentials) is touched; the owner's own act of placing the API key in a prior cycle is affirmative evidence of entitlement and of owner awareness of the channel. (2) Use pattern is internal research, bytes pinned (UNTRACKED_NEVER_COMMITTED, sha-verified by me), no redistribution path exists in the factory; this is the canonical permitted use of a subscriber's own market-data pulls, and the missing terms TEXT is a documentation gap, not evidence of out-of-scope access. (3) Data identity/integrity -- the thing that determines whether results are valid -- is proven independently of license terms: 4/4 byte-pinned pairs, deterministic double-pull precedent, sample-proven provenance vs the V1 snapshot class that V8 scored on. (4) The gap was self-disclosed by the lane in the proof artifact and the ruling event, explicitly flagged for this audit and for the owner terminal report -- the opposite of concealment. (5) The standing delegation grants full Lead autonomy for the one-shot run; authorizing an internally-entitled data source is within that autonomy. HOWEVER two obligations follow and are NOT yet satisfied: (a) the gate's declared source of truth must actually record the authorization WITH recorded terms before GO -- that is finding A7-NG1-H1 (mechanical, blocking, trivially fixable: commit the proof update together with the Twelve Data terms URL/text and entitlement evidence); (b) Twelve Data sits OUTSIDE plan sec3's frozen S2/S3 plane set ('exactly GRANTED S2/S3 series, nothing else ... Every series outside the frozen set stays BLOCKED_DATA') -- the spot channel rests on the p1_spot proof + A1 ruling + run-contract data_pins instead of a GA4 grant. I judge this tension resolved IN SUBSTANCE by the delegation and by the plan's own phase design (honest CANDIDATE proof first, ruling second, fail-closed adapter throughout), but it is a plan-text deviation that MUST be carried into the terminal report, and any future cycle should route the spot channel through the platform authority table the same way S2/S3 are. Had the entitlement itself been doubtful, or had raw bytes been committed/redistributed, I would have graded the terms gap HIGH and refused on it independently.
authority_assessment.grading: terms gap itself: MEDIUM (documentation/compliance, disclosed, does not affect result validity); gate-not-executed: HIGH (A7-NG1-H1, the refusal driver)

assumption_audit: Fresh-context audit; no implementer input accepted or sought. Every load-bearing number was recomputed from bytes, not trusted from artifacts: commit ordering from git ancestry on two branches (not from messages), file/pin/manifest digests with my own sha256 calls, arm digests by re-running the frozen digest function on committed proposal bytes, the full dry-run by re-executing it from the detached ffdc128 tree with independently-verified DGS10 bytes (7/7 output files byte-identical to committed), leak detection by my own recursive full-depth key scan in addition to the built-in scanner, and governance from the ROOT registry (I initially flagged head=0000/PLANNED_NOT_STARTED from the stale worktree copy before correcting to the root authority row -- the registry's own commit history b900cd2/fc61d18 settles it). Assumptions I could NOT verify and therefore did not rely on: (1) that the E-phase controller will read the adjudication mapping rather than the stale contract arms list -- hence M1; (2) that the owner entitlement genuinely covers programmatic daily-bars pulls at this volume -- bytes and precedent say the channel works, only a human/owner record can say the license does, hence the terms recording obligation in the authority assessment; (3) that no outcome computation ever ran outside committed evidence -- I verified absence in the tree, tests, and call sites, but a computation on an untracked scratch cannot be excluded by construction anywhere in any repo; the heavy-lock registry and budget counter show 0/6 used and no Stage-A artifacts exist, which is the strongest attainable evidence. What would change my verdict: executing A7-NG1-H1's committed gate flip with recorded terms resolves the only HIGH; no other finding blocks launch. One file was written by this audit (this one); the detached tree /tmp/a7p_forex_ng1 and A7 scratch dirs are removed after writing.
